figmaCorrections.element: Column-header text token vs rendered color
figmaCorrections.issue: Header text is bound to the Text/Hint variable (#374151) but Figma's generated code renders it as literal #6b7280, so the variable and the rendered value disagree. This ambiguity makes 'source of truth' unclear for devs (see UTH-MANAGE-OUTCOME-001).
figmaCorrections.recommendation: Reconcile the Text/Hint token: either bind header text to a variable that resolves to #6b7280 or re-point Text/Hint, so token and rendered color match exactly.

figmaCorrections.element: Table body cell text color token
figmaCorrections.issue: Cell text is documented as both Text/Dark token (#374151) and is the same variable used elsewhere as Text/Hint, overloading one variable name for two roles.
figmaCorrections.recommendation: Split into distinct Text/Dark and Text/Hint variables with unambiguous hex so cell, header, and hint colors are independently controllable.
